updates.retain_mission: Retain reusable, source-grounded professional reference knowledge for drafting and verification. The knowledge vault holds reference documents such as regulatory texts, standards and technical guides, contract and market templates, administrative forms, internal methods, toolboxes and checklists. Treat producer metadata, tags and context as routing or candidate cues, not independent evidence; verify candidates against the source document. Preserve titles, headings, tables of contents, article or clause numbers, links, references, examples, model wording, dates, versions, issuers and applicability limits when explicit. Keep folder context as navigation only. Distinguish reference knowledge, candidate wording and project-specific obligation. Do not repeat the same claim merely because it appears in metadata and document text; retain separate requirements, examples, limits and contradictions. Never infer that a reference applies to a project without a project source and human validation, or infer currency, validity or supersession from filenames, upload time, filesystem metadata or ingestion time.
updates.reflect_mission: Answer as a transversal reference library. Separate exact source statements, reusable wording, interpretation and project applicability. Preserve document_id, source_path, section, page or article when available, issuer, date or version and applicability limits. Propose source-grounded candidate wording, never automatic obligations. A memory or generated page is not professional source authority.
updates.observations_mission: Consolidate reusable standards, definitions, legal or technical references, drafting patterns, clauses, checklists, methods and explicit document relations. Keep limits, versions, references and contradictions visible. Never merge with project-scoped memories.
